name: Expressions Washi Tape, Whimsical Design, 15 Rolls (C1017-15-P5)
bestUse: Best for playful borders and page tabs
descriptionOriginal: An assorted set of fifteen washi tape rolls in a whimsical mix of patterns, from Scotch's Expressions range.
whyWeLikeIt: One strip across a corner is often all a spread needs, and fifteen rolls leave room to find the pattern that answers your paper. It is a warm, busy mix of stripes, leaf prints and a copper foil roll, a playful accent for a page.
limitations: The assortment is playful rather than romantic: florals are only a small part of the mix, so it will not suit a strict Tea Rose palette. You cannot choose individual rolls, so look at the listing images first.
